entries.title: I Chronicles 25:1
segments:
CHAPTER XXV  
 
 
 
  The number and offices of the singers and players on musical 
   instruments; and their division by lot into twenty-four 
   courses, 1-31.
 
 NOTES ON CHAP. XXV 
 
Verse 1. David and the captains of the host] The chiefs of those who formed the several orders: not military captains. 
 
  Should prophesy] Should accompany their musical instruments with prayer and singing.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:2
segments: Verse 2. Which prophesied] Sung hymns and prayed. But the Targum understands this of prophesying in the proper sense of the term; and therefore says, "Who prophesied by the Holy Spirit." Jarchi is of the same opinion and quotes the case of Elisha,
; While the minstrel played, the hand of the Lord [i.e., the spirit of prophecy] was upon him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:3
segments: Verse 3. The sons of Jeduthun-six] That is, six with their father, otherwise, there are but five. Hence it is said, they were under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, &c.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:5
segments:
Verse 5. To lift up the horn] "The horn of prophecy," says Jarchi; "to sound with the trumpet in the words of prophecy before the Lord."-T. 
 
  Three daughters.] These also were employed among the singers.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:7
segments: Verse 7. Two hundred fourscore and eight.] That it twelve classes of twenty-four Levites each; for two hundred and eighty-eight divided by twelve quotes twenty-four.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:9
segments:
Verse 9. For Asaph to Joseph] His first-born. 
 
  The second to Gedaliah] The first-born of Jeduthun.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:10
segments: Verse 10. The third to Zaccur] The first-born of Asaph.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:11
segments: Verse 11. The fourth to Izri] The second son of Jeduthun.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:12
segments: Verse 12. The fifth to Nethaniah] The third son of Asaph. Thus we find the lot did not run in any particular kind of order.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:14
segments: Verse 14. Jesharelah] Supposed to be the same with Uzziel, son of Heman.

entries.title: I Chronicles 25:31
segments: Verse 31. Romamti-ezer] Both these names belong to the same person. He is mentioned also

. 
 
With this immense parade of noise and show, (David's own invention,) Christianity has nothing to do.
